name: Jake the Kitty Caterer and the Sweet Treats of Doom!
source:
Jake is your average high schooler, he goes to school, studies, and hangs out with his friends! But what happens when his life is turned upside down by a talking cat and he is now forced to fight evil desserts from another world!? 

[From [url=https://maxiewaxiewoo.itch.io/jake-the-kitty-caterer-and-the-sweet-treats-of-doom]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
杰克是一个普通的高中生，他上学、学习、和朋友们一起出去玩！但当他的生活被一只会说话的猫搅乱，他现在被迫与来自另一个世界的邪恶甜点作斗争时，会发生什么呢？

[来自[url=https://maxiewaxiewoo.itch.io/jake-the-kitty-caterer-and-the-sweet-treats-of-doom]Itch.io[/url]]
